snippet.title: My Little Cafe Nightmare – Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in My Little Cafe Nightmare, a dark and cozy first-person café experience where your customers are anything but ordinary.

Manage your supplies, upgrade your shop and slowly transform a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst the nightmares.

Wishlist My Little Cafe Nightmare now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726250/My_Little_Cafe_Nightmare/
